record.dic_text:
5141 tremo {trem'-o}

從原形 treo ("驚恐","驚懼") 的加強; 動詞

欽定本 - tremble 4; 4

1) 顫抖 (#可5:33;路8:47|)
2) (面對超然而有的) 戰兢, 敬畏 (#徒9:6;彼後2:10|)

同義詞 見 5841
record.edic_text:
5141 tremo {trem'-o}

strengthened from a primary treo (to "dread", "terrify");; v

AV - tremble 4; 4

1) tremble
2) to fear, be afraid

For Synonyms see entry 5841

same.cexp: 戰慄的，恐懼的，戰戰兢兢的
